activity_statements.statement: underwrites personal and commercial lines property and casualty insurance for policyholders across the US through a network of 30,000+ independent agents
operates as a mutual insurance company (policyholder-owned), holding $9.2B+ in total assets with A+ ratings from both AM Best and Standard & Poor's
assigns dedicated claims specialists to policyholders for end-to-end claims handling, accessible by phone, online, or mobile app
distributes products exclusively through independent insurance agents (not captive agents), providing multi-carrier choice and expert advice to policyholders
operates a mobile app (4.8-star iOS, 4.7-star Android) enabling digital ID cards, claims reporting, roadside assistance, and bill payment for policyholders
provides deep industry-specific commercial insurance expertise for business segments it serves, leveraging 100+ years of underwriting experience

name_reality_gap: none — Acuity Insurance's name accurately describes the company; the mutual structure and independent-agent-only distribution are the less-obvious facts.
extraction_notes: acuity.com/about-acuity and acuity.com/insurance timed out; homepage provided solid content including claims model, agent distribution, mutual structure, and financial ratings. Limited segment detail available.
